weakness: Seasonal and leaver accounts disabled late; no account reviews; transfers keep old access; shared intake mailbox credential never changed

remediation_plan: Set end dates at account creation; same-day disable from the HR ticket; quarterly access reviews; transfer checklist
milestones: 2026-10-31 end dates and same-day disable live; 2026-12-31 first quarterly review complete

weakness: Legacy authentication bypasses MFA on 4 service mailboxes; push MFA without number matching

milestones: 2026-09-15 legacy authentication blocked and intake mailbox converted (R-033); 2026-11-30 number matching for all users

remediation_plan: Send tax software, DMS, identity, and mailbox logs to a log workspace with one-year retention; alert rules; monthly review by the Qualified Individual

weakness: No after-hours monitoring; sign-in anomalies, inbox rules, and bulk exports not detected

milestones: 2026-11-30 contract signed; 2027-01-15 live before the filing season

weakness: No vulnerability scan since 2025-03; no remediation time frames; VPN gateway firmware was behind

milestones: 2026-08-06 VPN firmware updated (done); 2026-11-30 first monthly scan and remediation report
resources_required: Included in the $18,000 a year testing budget
